The Job: Accounts Assistant
Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree: The candidate should have a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field from a recognized university or institute. A higher degree such as a Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration may be preferred.
Experience:                                             Minimum 2-3 years Tally ERP 9, Tally Prime, MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access)
Location: Mysuru
Employment Type: Permanent
Roles and Responsibilities: Payment
  • Take the prior approval from Head of the Institution and registrar before doing any payment
  • Be responsible for all the payments
Receipt
  • Monitor Students online payment
  • Generate a receipt based on the payment.
  • Update of fee structure to the software team through which the fee is received.
  • Monitor the accounts book of students’ association and professional body and any other associated accounts
  • Process Gratuity and do the payment
  • Do IT calculations
  • Do Salary calculation based on deductions
  • Be responsible for all types of refunds
  • Do reconciliation of bank accounts
  • Generate bank reconciliation report & submit the same to the auditor k) Submit GST bills to auditor at the end of the month
  • Do the submission of TDS deducted statements to auditor at the end of the month
  • To attend any other work that will be assigned by the higher authorities.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
